lines.zh: 我在深海里飘，八条腕一起划。
lines.en: I drift in the deep, all eight arms rowing.

lines.zh: 我的身体圆鼓鼓的，有东西在里面。
lines.en: My body is round and swollen. There's something inside.
I float up, then sink back.
I move along the stones on the seabed.

lines.zh: 水压变了，我知道有多深。
lines.en: The pressure tells me how deep I am.
I slide down the trench edge.
My arms arrive first, the body follows.

lines.zh: 我贴着海底的沉石滑过去。
lines.en: I slide past a sunken rock on the seabed.
No light here. Good.

lines.zh: 水流推着我，我顺势漂走。
lines.en: The current pushes me and I drift away.
The thing inside me sways.
I head into deeper dark.
I swim over a field of bones.
I stop and wait a while.
Then I sink on down.
The deep is vast. I move slowly.
I hang with my arms hanging down.

lines.zh: 我身体里有东西在搏动。
lines.en: Something pulses inside me.
A swell, then a pause.
Slow, but not uneven.

lines.zh: 我在等一个被扔下来的。
lines.en: I'm waiting to be thrown.
Someone will throw me.

lines.zh: 到那时候，我就不一样了。
lines.en: Then I'll be something else.
For now I only hang here.
My arm tips draw in the sand.
A circle.
I've drawn many circles.
They surround me.
I'm a little sleepy in the deep.

lines.zh: 深海底下，从来看不见天。
lines.en: Down here the sky never shows.

lines.zh: 你潜得越深，我鼓得越圆。
lines.en: The deeper you dive, the rounder I swell.
You have a lamp, and it finds me.
I turn my arms the other way.
That lamp is still following me.
I have eight arms.
How many do you have?

lines.zh: 我数不清你，可我看得出你在怕。
lines.en: I can't count you, but I see you're afraid.
There's something in your hand.
Are you trying to grab me?
You'll regret it.
I've been squashed flat.
And slowly swelling back.
What's inside is sloshing badly.
I let out a little ink.
The water around me goes black.

lines.zh: 深海里的墨，一炸就是一片。
lines.en: Deep-sea ink bursts into a cloud.
One arm is gone.
The piece still moves.
On the sand of the sea floor.

lines.zh: 墨汁漏出来，海水都黑了。
lines.en: Ink leaks out and the seawater turns black.
Is that a fish in your hand?

lines.zh: 克拉肯把我当炸弹扔出去。
lines.en: The Kraken throws me like a bomb.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的手转了一整圈。
lines.en: I swim one full circle around your hand.
It doesn't move at all.
I put out one arm.
An arm of mine has touched it.
That isn't a fish at all.
I draw my arm back.

lines.zh: 你手里那条鱼，我先看看。
lines.en: Let me look at that fish in your hand first.

lines.zh: 这种饵，我早就不上当了。
lines.en: I stopped falling for that bait long ago.
You hit me and I squash a little.
It swells slowly back.

lines.zh: 这一下，里面的东西晃了。
lines.en: That shook what's inside.
I back off half an arm's length.
My arms wrap around your hand.
My arms slide off your hand.
I shouldn't have held so tight.
You shook it off.
I drift down slowly.
Further from you.

lines.zh: 深海里，我们不怎么见面。
lines.en: We don't meet much in the deep.
Sometimes there's a group.

lines.zh: 我们排成一行，一起往上。
lines.en: We line up and rise together.
At a certain height we scatter.
Some stay below.
Some get thrown.
The thrown ones make a sound.
And then they're gone.
The rest keep going down.
That's our life.
I coil an arm around it.

lines.zh: 我的身体圆鼓鼓的，把它送到嘴边。
lines.en: Round and swollen, I bring it to my mouth.
One bite. Not much good.
I push the thing back out.

lines.zh: 它慢慢沉下去，墨囊已经空了。
lines.en: It sinks slowly; the ink sac is empty.

lines.zh: 我捡起贝壳，塞进腕缝里。
lines.en: I pick up a shell and tuck it between my arms.
This time I keep it.
Tucked between my arms.
I tuck it in and carry it.
Down somewhere deeper.
Something's coming down from above.
It's coming down slowly.
It's carrying a lamp.
I gather my arms in.
Pressed to the rock.
The light passes over.
The light has found me.
It has stopped there.

lines.zh: 上面有东西下来，它带着一盏灯。
lines.en: Something descends with a lamp.

lines.zh: 我把腕张开，朝你漂过去。
lines.en: I spread my arms and drift toward you.
I rise with it.
It thinks I'm fleeing.
I am going up.
Just the same direction.
It swims faster than I do.
I wait for it to look back.
It looked back and down.
I'm still below.
It goes on up.
There's a stretch of water between us.
I ram into it.
Eight arms coil tight; I count to three.
It can't pull free of my arms.
The thing inside me starts to sound.
That isn't pain.
It's counting down.

lines.zh: 腕尖一收，你就被抱住了。
lines.en: My arm tips close and you are caught.
It's pulling back.

lines.zh: 我把你往克拉肯那边拖。
lines.en: I drag you toward the Kraken.
On three, it bursts.
I float up from the trench floor.

lines.zh: 深海压下来，我在这里胀大。
lines.en: The deep sea presses down; I swell here.
I spread my arms slowly.

lines.zh: 身体里的东西还在搏动。
lines.en: The thing inside keeps pulsing.
I try rising.
The pressure drops.
The pressure has risen again.
Something warm is nearby.
I swing my arms that way.
A thin thread of light.

lines.zh: 火到水里还烧，我往深处沉。
lines.en: The fire burns even underwater. I sink deeper.

lines.zh: 我从水面掉回海里，摔得发闷。
lines.en: I fall back into the sea and hit dully.

lines.zh: 我本来就是水里的，可水在挤我。
lines.en: I'm a sea creature, and the water is crushing me.
The blast comes from inside me.

lines.zh: 箭在水里变慢，仍扎进墨囊。
lines.en: The arrow slows underwater but still pierces my ink sac.
A light pins me in the water.

lines.zh: 这里什么都没有，我一直空着。
lines.en: Nothing here. I've been empty.

lines.zh: 雷打进海里，我的腕足全伸直了。
lines.en: Lightning enters the sea and my arms snap straight.
No water here. I can't breathe.
